kinds.Name: action
kinds.Description: Checks for popular actions released on GitHub, local actions, and action calls at "uses:"

kinds.Name: deprecated-commands
kinds.Description: Checks for deprecated "set-output", "save-state", "set-env", and "add-path" commands at "run:"

kinds.Name: env-var
kinds.Description: Checks for environment variables configuration at "env:"

kinds.Name: events
kinds.Description: Checks for workflow trigger events at "on:"

kinds.Name: expression
kinds.Description: Syntax and semantics checks for expressions embedded with ${{ }} syntax

kinds.Name: glob
kinds.Description: Checks for glob syntax used in branch names, tags, and paths

kinds.Name: id
kinds.Description: Checks for duplication and naming convention of job/step IDs

kinds.Name: if-cond
kinds.Description: Checks for if: conditions which are always true/false

kinds.Name: job-needs
kinds.Description: Checks for job IDs in "needs:". Undefined IDs and cyclic dependencies are checked

kinds.Name: permissions
kinds.Description: Checks for permissions configuration in "permissions:". Permission names and permission scopes are checked

kinds.Name: runner-label
kinds.Description: Checks for GitHub-hosted and preset self-hosted runner labels in "runs-on:"

kinds.Name: shell-name
kinds.Description: Checks for shell names used for scripts in "run:"

kinds.Name: shellcheck
kinds.Description: Checks for shell script sources in "run:" using shellcheck

kinds.Name: syntax-check
kinds.Description: Checks for GitHub Actions workflow syntax

kinds.Name: workflow-call
kinds.Description: Checks for reusable workflow calls. Inputs and outputs of called reusable workflow are checked
